reviewer: Codex: first-use outline, source and native transcript-output review
review_scope: Local bundle import, text-only speaker review, source preservation and case registration only. Fixed regression interpretation is not a learner action, live voice test, recorded audio or hosted transcription. No advisory claims or approvals are created. Source dependency refresh after the localized advisory evidence-map repair: 35 current presentation/transcript checks pass in clara-teaching-source-refresh-02. All 60 recorded primary/supporting artifacts across these three kits are byte-identical to the previously inspected versions; the parity manifest retains actual paths. Existing editorial and visual judgments are preserved for unchanged material. No new voice, learner or GUI acceptance is asserted.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title and ordinary note-import case teach the supported local transcript route from bundle and destination through reviewed text and source registration. The lesson explicitly separates new audio capture/transcription, which is not exercised.
editorial.inputs_and_request: The two fictional authored-text bundles are valid native inputs with a localized provenance note. The natural request names the case, preservation, speaker review and final text, without requiring the beginner to understand JSON fields. No audio or hosted-service result is falsely represented as real.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The actual native importer and finalizer preserve originals, register the model-reviewed transcript and retain the first session when the second is added. Voice follows the working chat. Checkpoints identify the source/destination and compare one passage in both versions.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The finalizer registers a short readable Markdown transcript, with its current path and source hash in the actual material/evidence registries. Its words match the source; no service decision or advisory claim is added. The original importer attribution report is retained as import-time evidence; the current material record points to the final reviewed text.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The second bundle has two unverified speakers. The exercise preserves their localized numbered labels and the earlier note, then repeats source comparison. The closing guidance distinguishes ordinary-folder storage from case-evidence review and registration.
editorial.language_and_pacing: The it outline, source note and final transcript were read in full. Final prose follows that language. Raw importer metadata and registry headings mostly remain English (Spanish import headings are localized); these are supporting source records, not a promised fully translated interface. The six-section explanation totals 390 seconds, a target rather than measured learner time.

demo.result_review: Read the actual finalized transcript and its native registration. Sara is named from explicit self-identification and metadata; price, route and launch remain unresolved. Native checks verify exact source preservation, the current registered output path, transcript hashes, a valid case and an empty judgement log. The fixed text review is a regression fixture, not a learner review. No audio, hosted capture, or external truth verification occurred.

Primary artifact hashes here are from the current native runs.
refresh_review.retained_evidence: Prior supporting validation, registry and browser-QA artifacts are retained separately where they contain older run paths or timestamps. I reviewed the shared footer diff: French and German wording now uses the same formal address as the lesson. The original artifact reviews and their stated limitations are retained; this is not a new independent or learner review.
freshness_review.execution_review: Every supported locale and both phases have successful native test cases with the current canonical course fingerprint.
